visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Caption inside a figure
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The caption sits in a paragraph under the image. Group them with figure and figcaption. The text and the image must stay.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Sunset at the beach

solution.explanation: figure and figcaption tell the browser that the caption belongs to the image. Both can move together and a screen reader announces them as one unit.

checks.label: The image keeps its alt text
The caption text is on the page
